newsitem.title: USA: Netanyahu arrives ahead of Clinton meeting.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu arrives ahead of Clinton meeting.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in Washington on Sunday ahead of a meeting with President Bill Clinton on the latest crisis in the Middle East peace process.
Netanyahu travelled to Washington from Minnesota, where he met with Jordan's King Hussein earlier Sunday at a Mayo Clinic hospital where the monarch is recovering from prostrate surgery.

Netanyahu arrived at Andrews Air Force Base around 23:30 p.m. EDT (0330 GMT), a spokesman at the base said. The Israeli leader travelled by motorcade to Washington, where he will meet Clinton at the White House at noon EDT (1600 GMT) on Monday.
